status: analysis plan fixed before supplementary outcomes; code freeze follows independent review
purpose: Characterise locality-accuracy sensitivity and longer-budget behaviour, not choose best G or erase worst seed
unchanged: Architecture64-256-64-10,raw batch98,T50,dt3,learning rates/initialization/negative generation and historical train/valid split from previous study; same validation after every epoch
pairing: Same ten seeds across all groups, initial weights and RNG schedule checked. Encoder keys will be passively recorded; no additional training/evaluation calls. Epoch5 prefixes retained for G1/G8 longer runs.
statistical_unit: paired training seed, n10. No pooling validation samples or pooling historical20 seeds.

group_curve_analysis.point_estimate: mean paired difference in percentage points
group_curve_analysis.interval: familywise95% Bonferroni intervals: each two-sided98.75% Student t df9; pointwise95% may be shown labelled descriptive
group_curve_analysis.interpretation: Even a favourable interval does not select a replacement G or establish independent-data generalization; include all curves and per-seed outcomes

long_budget_analysis.role: separate budget robustness check, not a replacement for original 20-pair primary claim
long_budget_analysis.interaction: paired [G8-G1 at20] minus [G8-G1 at5] with descriptive95%t interval; not a second pass/fail test

individual_risk: report number/proportion of negative paired differences and differences below -1pp, min/median/max; descriptive empirical seed frequencies, not calibrated future-run failure probabilities
stop_rules: Run all50 fixed models without intermediate statistical stopping; preserve failed logs. Any nonfinite or integrity failure stops queue for code diagnosis, never replace algorithmic failed seeds silently. No changes to G,epochs,margin or learning rates after outcomes.
scope: Supplement designed after original results; same reused validation; new training seeds only. Not independent-data confirmation, convergence proof, patient/privacy/Dale result or measured system-efficiency claim.
